comment: Add 'unexclude' (clear_exclude): the missing symmetric undo for yield --exclude/--exclude-self. A worker's own self-exclusion (e.g. machine:only-box when that machine is the lane's only permitted one) previously had no way to be undone -- it permanently starved the task with no error, card, or dead-letter signal, just silent, invisible starvation. New CLI: 'agent-dispatch unexclude <task> [--exclude TOKEN]' (omit --exclude to clear all).
